replication.target_description: Replication attention reaction-time task in a student sample. The broad description and p. 726 locator do not distinguish the Group main effect, face-valence main effect, Group × Valence interaction, GAD-only valence ANOVA, or GAD angry-versus-neutral post hoc comparison. Author-stated critical claim concerns likely GAD angry versus neutral faces (Discussion, p. 728); the reported GAD omnibus test covers all three valences.
